mypy.scope: Default mypy checks; not strict mode or --check-untyped-defs. Pyright also analyzes source bodies.

corrections.change: Checked object decoding for device journals, owned jobs, external-request graphs, cancellation requests and intents. Lease state and unresolved recovery prompts are explicitly checked before use. Existing locks, request bindings, terminal proofs, archives and no-resubmission rules remain active.

Profiles, telemetry, guard records, calibrations and replay receipts decode through the checked object boundary. Missing history and non-object telemetry are retained as issues or admission refusals. Observer identity and cold/warm session collection types are explicit.

Initialize the local run record as absent and only update it after construction. A run-directory race preserves the original FileExistsError and any existing record while stopping the owned job and releasing its lease; no worker request is published.

Validated SDXL and FLUX specifications return checked independent dictionaries. Qualification graphs and receipts use checked decoding. Review packets explicitly require captured evaluation evidence. Fractional batch timing arguments retain their supported float types.
Artifact and execution-receipt readers return checked dictionaries. Owner jobs and recorded worker ports are narrowed before indexing. Inventory catalog metadata can contain the recovery boolean.

The downloader unit tests now specify free disk capacity. They exercise exact-budget success, hash/length rejection, existing-file preservation and refusal one byte below the reserve before any request or partial file. Production downloader and its 1 GiB reserve were not changed.

targeted_pytest.counting: 444 broader regression passes plus 48 supplementary passes plus 4 corrected capacity cases. The initial eight-case focused run repeats cases in the broader run and is not added.

retained_failed_attempts.cause: Command referenced nonexistent tests/test_inference_capabilities.py; corrected selection in pytest-regression-run2.xml.
Downloader tests depended on actual C: free capacity. Observed free bytes 48783360 were below the production 1 GiB reserve, so intended hash/length assertions were not reached.
retained_failed_attempts.resolution: Explicit test capacity and a new insufficient-space boundary case; all four cases passed in pytest-download-capacity.xml. Original failed report retained.
